queries.result: Only exact-title visible candidate was inspected and rejected; no reliable mapping.

rejected_candidates.statement_read: Markets are placed at equal subdivisions of a circle. A trade route goes to a farthest market; route segments must not intersect except at endpoints. Maximize the count of routes. Input gives circumference subdivisions and market positions; output one integer.
rejected_candidates.rejection_basis: CSP201712E is a rooted tree with parent/s/v/f input and descendant-jump profits v_u-(f_u-dist(u,v))^2, asking for the sum of optimal profits modulo 10^18. Both data model and objective differ.

limitations: Non-empty queries use fuzzy search; only the first 50 visible results were inspected. No pagination through hundreds of unrelated candidates was attempted.
